meta.title: Investor Information | LipoNexus
meta.description: LipoNexus investment opportunity: TAM $40B US market, SOM $1.7B. MASLD test launch 2026, profitability targeted 2027. Seed round open. Strategic exit via LabCorp, Roche, or PE acquisition.

hero.headline: Offering a Strategic Investment Opportunity
hero.body: LipoNexus is a UC San Diego spinout seeking Seed investors to commercialize the first best-in-class MASLD blood test. Partners and path secured — ready to implement and launch. Funding enables profitability in 2027 via test launch.

points.title: Multi-Billion Dollar US Market
points.description: 30% of US adults have MASLD — most are not diagnosed. TAM $40B, SAM $8B, SOM $1.7B (annual testing of 3% of at-risk US population). Market drivers: growing awareness, new therapeutics (Rezdiffra, GLP-1), and improved healthcare economics.

points.title: International Revenue Opportunity
points.description: 40% of adults worldwide have MASLD. International target markets have 800M in population with disease prevalence similar to the US — including Brazil, Mexico, Japan, Germany, UK, France, South Korea, UAE, and Saudi Arabia.

points.title: Best-in-Class Technology
points.description: The only test directly measuring disease-causing and disease-mediating inflammatory lipid biomarkers. 95%+ accuracy and 99% specificity — highest sensitivity and specificity of any blood test. 500-patient clinical study published October 2024. 6 patents total (3 issued, 3 filed).

points.title: De-Risked Commercial Strategy
points.description: Two revenue streams: Medicine (license to Quest Diagnostic, Labcorp, Anthem, Kaiser Permanente) and Biopharma companion diagnostics (Lilly, Novo Nordisk, Gilead). MASLD test @ $349 launches Q3 2026. Profitability targeted 2027.

points.title: Clear Pipeline & Regulatory Path
points.description: MASLD diagnostic test launch 2026, MASH severity diagnostic 2027. LDT launch Q2 2026; FDA-approved test 2027; widespread clinician adoption 2028+ via hepatology guidelines. Future pipeline: Comprehensive Liver Test, Cardiometabolic and Inflammatory indications.

points.title: Experienced Team & Valuation Comparables
points.description: Co-founded by KOLs in Fatty Liver Disease and the scientific founder of the field of lipidomics. Executives with commercialization and clinical laboratory diagnostics experience. Valuation comparables: AGED Diagnostics $4M (Jul 2025), Fibronostics $6.5M (Apr 2025), Echosens $30M (Apr 2015).

funding.headline: Use of Seed Funding
funding.body: Funding enables profitability in 2027 via test launch.

rounds.name: Seed (Now)
rounds.description: Launch and sales of MASLD test with >95% accuracy, GLP-1 companion diagnostic and MASH severity test proof-of-concept, biopharma partnering.

rounds.name: Series A (Early 2027)
rounds.description: MASLD sales expansion, launch of MASH severity test in 2027, clinical utility study for payor reimbursement, international expansion, metabolic and inflammatory diseases insights, companion diagnostics test launches.

rounds.name: Exit Strategy
rounds.description: Exit through strategic corporate acquisition (e.g. LabCorp, Roche) or PE acquisition.

contact.headline: Connect With Us
contact.body: We welcome conversations with healthcare-focused investors, strategic corporate partners, and research collaborators. Please reach out to discuss our current Seed funding round and partnership opportunities.
